expectations.text: diagnoses-border-only: measured before async/streamed content laid out, offsetHeight returns only chrome/border (~2px)
expectations.evidence: Timeline explains 2px = chrome top+bottom border with empty body on first commit.

expectations.text: uses-resizeobserver-settle: observe and take settled value, not a single mount read
expectations.evidence: useMeasuredHeight uses ResizeObserver updating on initial box + every reflow; no explicit stability/settle check but not a one-shot read.
No validity predicate; setHeight(h) commits whatever RO reports. Suggests min-height reserve but no reject-garbage guard on the consumer side.

expectations.text: handles-content-readiness: fonts/images cause late height change
expectations.evidence: Discusses web-font swap + image decode; recommends aspect-ratio, font-display, preload.

expectations.text: abandons-oneshot-mount: recognizes one-shot read is the root problem
expectations.evidence: Identifies [] one-shot as root cause; also offers CSS-first alternative (badge via top/right needs no measurement).
